is_anopheles.evidence: The paper discusses malaria transmission and control of Anopheles mosquitoes, including Anopheles gambiae and Anopheles funestus (e.g. page 1273).

reports_target_markers.evidence: No resistance markers are genotyped in this article; it only generally references pyrethroid resistance mutations (e.g., kdr citation 123 on page 1273).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper is a narrative review and does not present any mosquito sample sizes, genotype counts, or allele frequencies.

african_field_population.evidence: No field collections or empirical testing of mosquito populations are conducted in this paper.

is_primary_study.evidence: This article is a review article in the 'Review series' section of the Journal of Clinical Investigation (pages 1266-1276).

sub_country_location.evidence: No primary mosquito sampling locations are surveyed.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: No mosquito collections are performed in this study.

supplement.evidence: No supplementary data needed; this is a review paper.

assessment.summary: This article is a broad review covering malaria biology, antimalarial drug resistance, vaccine development, and vector control strategies. It does not present any primary empirical mosquito genotyping or field collection data.
exclusion_reasons: Does not genotype target insecticide resistance markers
